title: Nourishing Fluffy Mexican Khus Khus Tacos
description:
A pescatarian-friendly, one-pot Mexican dish from Oaxaca, featuring khus khus and a sweet glaze.

This recipe is perfect for a weeknight meal, as it's quick and easy to make, with minimal cleanup.

The khus khus adds a unique texture and nutty flavor to the dish, while the glaze provides a sweet and sticky element.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chipotle peppers, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the khus khus and chicken broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 10-12 minutes, or until the khus khus is tender.
Stir in the agave nectar and lime juice.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the khus khus mixture onto a tortilla, and topping with cilantro, a squeeze of lime juice, and a sprinkle of salt.
